This document is an update of the endorsed RP-222624 [9]. TEI CRs are CRs for small technical enhancements and improvements that use the WI code TEIxx (e.g. TEI16). As the 3GPP work is structured in work items (that describe and justify new work and that are documented in the 3GPP work plan) and as TEI is an exceptional WI code which has no related work item description that has to be approved by a TSG before the work starts, TEI CRs can cause problems in terms of transparency and traceability. This problem affects esp. cat.B/C CRs that introduce/modify functionality, but also follow-up cat.F/A CRs to such cat.B/C CRs. At first a summary of the requirements that are further explained in section 3: A. TEI Work Item codes shall only be used for small technical enhancements and improvements. B. A TEI CR set shall be fully completed within one TSG cycle/quarter in all affected WGs. C. TEI Work Item codes shall not be used where another appropriate Work Item code exists. D. Inter-TSG aspect: D1. Normally, for TSG SA/CT work that requires cat.B/C CRs from RAN WGs a RAN WI is required. D2. [CR CR0646r1 for 38.214] Reason for change: Based on the RAN2 LS R1-2407592(R2-2407827), several higher layer parameter names in 38.214 have been modified in order to reflect the ASN.1 names. NR_MIMO_evo_DL_UL-Core In clause 5.2.1.4.3, group based beam reporting was agreed and specified in Rel-18 for STx2P. In the TS 38.214, detailed L1-RSRP reporting format is not specified for the Rel-18 group based beam reporting (when the higher layer parameter groupBasedBeamReporting-r18 is configured). As the Rel-18 group based beam reporting is an extension of the Rel-17 group based beam reporting by allowing simultaneous transmission, differential L1-RSRP reporting format for the Rel-17 group based beam reporting should be applicable to the Rel-18 group based beam reporting.
